subject: English
stimulus: (a) It matters little to me whether ⎯⎯. (b) He pretended as if ⎯⎯. (c) If I had the wings of a bird, ⎯⎯. (d) Take your umbrella lest ⎯⎯. (e) Hardly had he started for school ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: (a) It matters little to me whether you like me or not. (b) He pretended as if he were innocent. (c) If I had the wings of a bird, I would fly in the sky. (d) Take your umbrella lest you should be drenched in the rain. (e) Hardly had he started for school when the rain started.
